entries.title: CoNecessitation(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(Γ:Ctx)∀(𝛗:Fm)((𝘍,[]⊢‹𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗›)→(𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗)))
entries.comment: If a formula  is derived in 𝘍 from the empty context, then the formula 𝛗 is derived in 𝘍 from the context Γ. Why this holds for 𝘍: for an arbitrary theory 𝘞, concluding (𝘞, Γ⊢𝛗) from (𝘞, [] ⊢ ) requires 1-consistency / Σ₁-soundness of 𝘞 (and for the r.e. base theory 𝘛, asserting internal co-necessitation would by Löb's theorem 5.01 trivialize 𝘛). Because 𝘍 is a non-r.e. sound Henkin extension equipped with Soundness 3.73 ((𝘍, [] ⊢ ψ) → ⟦ψ⟧), instantiating 3.73 at ψ :=  directly yields (𝘍, Γ⊢𝛗).

entries.title: Quantifier “unique”(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:Fm)((!(z:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)⟷(∀(x:Class)∀(y:Class)((⟦𝛗[(x:Class.Expression)/‹z›]⟧∧(let z = y in ⟦𝛗⟧))→(x=y)))))

entries.title: Quantifier “exists and unique”(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:Fm)(𝘛,[]⊢‹(∃!(x:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)⟷((∃(x:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)∧!(x:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)›))

entries.title: Class comprehension axiom schema(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:Fm)∀(x:Name)∀(k:Class.Expression)(FFI((k:Class.Expression),‹x›,(𝛗:Fm))→(𝘛,[]⊢‹(⟦k⟧∈{⦃x⦄|⟦𝛗⟧})⟷((⟦k⟧ set)∧(let x = ⟦k⟧ in ⟦𝛗⟧))›)))

entries.title: Löb's theorem(WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:Fm)(𝘌,[]⊢‹(𝘛,[]⊢‹(𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)→⟦𝛗⟧›)→(𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)›))
entries.comment: Here 𝘌 ∈ {IΣ₁, PA, 𝘛, NBG, MK} is an unspecified elementary metatheory capable of proving the Hilbert-Bernays-Löb derivability conditions D1-D3 for the r.e. base theory 𝘛 (specifically D3, Σ₁-completeness, which requires Σ₁-induction and fails in Robinson's arithmetic Q; see Hájek & Pudlák 1993, Metamathematics of First-Order Arithmetic, Ch. I §3 & Ch. III; Bezboruah & Shepherdson 1976, JSL 41(2):503-512; Boolos 1993, The Logic of Provability, Ch. 2).

entries.title: Gödel's second incompleteness theorem(WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (𝘌,[]⊢‹(¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹⊥›))→¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹⊥›)›)›)
entries.comment: Formalized in the unspecified elementary metatheory 𝘌 ∈ {IΣ₁, PA, 𝘛, NBG, MK} (not Robinson's Q, which lacks Σ₁-induction needed for HBL condition D3; cf. Hájek & Pudlák 1993; Bezboruah & Shepherdson 1976) for the recursively enumerable object theory 𝘛. Note that Gödel's second incompleteness theorem applies to the r.e. theory 𝘛, whereas 𝘍 is non-r.e.
